record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764> on Neginoth<WH05058>, A Psalm<WH04210> <FI>or<Fi> Song<WH07892> of Asaph<WH0623>.<Fo><Fo> In Judah<WH03063> <FI>is<Fi> God<WH0430> known<WH03045><WTH8737>: his name<WH08034> <FI>is<Fi> great<WH01419> in Israel<WH03478>. <RF>chief...: or, overseer<Rf> <RF>of: or, for<Rf>

There brake<WH07665><WTH8765> he the arrows<WH07565> of the bow<WH07198>, the shield<WH04043>, and the sword<WH02719>, and the battle<WH04421>. Selah<WH05542>.
Thou <FI>art<Fi> more glorious<WH0215><WTH8737> <FI>and<Fi> excellent<WH0117> than the mountains<WH02042> of prey<WH02964>.

The stouthearted<WH047><WH03820> are spoiled<WH07997><WTH8709>, they have slept<WH05123><WTH8804> their sleep<WH08142>: and none of the men<WH0582> of might<WH02428> have found<WH04672><WTH8804> their hands<WH03027>.
At thy rebuke<WH01606>, O God<WH0430> of Jacob<WH03290>, both the chariot<WH07393> and horse<WH05483> are cast into a dead sleep<WH07290><WTH8737>.<CM>
Thou, <FI>even<Fi> thou, <FI>art<Fi> to be feared<WH03372><WTH8737>: and who may stand<WH05975><WTH8799> in thy sight<WH06440> when<WH0227> once thou art angry<WH0639>?
Thou didst cause judgment<WH01779> to be heard<WH08085><WTH8689> from heaven<WH08064>; the earth<WH0776> feared<WH03372><WTH8804>, and was still<WH08252><WTH8804>,
When God<WH0430> arose<WH06965><WTH8800> to judgment<WH04941>, to save<WH03467><WTH8687> all the meek<WH06035> of the earth<WH0776>. Selah<WH05542>.
Surely the wrath<WH02534> of man<WH0120> shall praise<WH03034><WTH8686> thee: the remainder<WH07611> of wrath<WH02534> shalt thou restrain<WH02296><WTH8799>.

Vow<WH05087><WTH8798>, and pay<WH07999><WTH8761> unto the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>: let all that be round about<WH05439> him bring<WH02986><WTH8686> presents<WH07862> unto him that ought to be feared<WH04172>. <RF>unto him...: Heb. to fear<Rf>
He shall cut off<WH01219><WTH8799> the spirit<WH07307> of princes<WH05057>: <FI>he is<Fi> terrible<WH03372><WTH8737> to the kings<WH04428> of the earth<WH0776>.<CM>
